rows.query: What inspections are proposed for the ball pivot and yaw actuator on EC135 and EC635 helicopters after a broken control rod caused loss of tail rotor control?
Is there a proposed AD requiring inspection of pilot and copilot seat locking pins for engagement with seat track detent holes and wear on McDonnell Douglas DC-9, MD-80, and MD-90-30 airplanes?
Is there a proposed AD for Airbus A330-243, -243F, -841 and -941 airplanes that supersedes the earlier AFM and MEL revisions for dual loss of RMP data synchronization and now requires a modification?
Is there a proposed AD requiring an AFM revision for Bombardier Challenger 600, 601, and 604 airplanes because of tail strikes when landing with partial flaps?
Is there a proposed AD for Rolls-Royce Trent 7000-72 and 7000-72C engines requiring repeated borescope inspections of HPT blades for axial cracking and removing the reduced life limit?
Is there a proposed AD requiring repeated engine beam crack inspections and a new life limit with replacement on Cessna/Textron 402C and 414A airplanes?
Was the proposed rule requiring repetitive inspections and overhaul or replacement of outboard mid-flap carriage spindles on Boeing 737-100 through -500 airplanes withdrawn?

What is the proposed AD for Airbus Helicopters AS355 series helicopters about tail rotor drive fan wheels and impeller second stage that were incorrectly identified in production, requiring serial number checks and borescope inspection?
Is there a proposed AD requiring a one-time eddy current inspection of the lower main wing spar bolt holes for fatigue cracks on Piper PA-28 and PA-32 airplanes after a wing separation?
Was the proposed AD for Dassault Falcon 2000 airplanes requiring inspection of hydraulic shut-off valve actuator serial numbers withdrawn?

Is there a proposed AD for Pilatus PC-6 series airplanes that revises the airworthiness limitations section with new, more restrictive limits, including eddy current inspections of the wing-to-fuselage fittings?

Was the proposed AD requiring revised Airworthiness Limitations Section items (fatigue crack and corrosion inspections, service life limits) for Airbus A330-200/-300 and A340-200/-300/-541/-642 withdrawn?

We operate a Boeing 737-800 (certificated in the transport category). One of our lavatories still has the original bifold door latch, part number SC1L500031-3/20218-3. I'm looking at the proposed AD that would require replacing lavatory bifold door latches with an improved design. This followed a report of a passenger who couldn't get out of the lavatory in flight because a broken latch kept the lock from toggling. Does this proposed AD apply to our airplane?

I operate a Bombardier Challenger 300, model BD-100-1A10, and a proposed AD would revise the AFM so the AP STAB TRIM FAIL advisory becomes an emergency procedure, because of pitch upset after autopilot disconnect. My airplane is actually a Bombardier Global 5000, model BD-700-1A11, so does that proposed AD apply to it?

We operate an Airbus Canada A220-300, model BD-500-1A11. I'm looking at the proposed AD that would supersede the earlier one requiring maintenance program revisions for new or more restrictive airworthiness limitations on the BD-500-1A10 and BD-500-1A11. Does it apply to us? I don't know which revision of the A220 Airworthiness Limitations document (BD500-3AB48-11400-02) is currently incorporated in our maintenance program, so I can't say whether Issue 019.01 dated August 28, 2025, or a later revision has been incorporated.

We operate an Airbus SAS Model A300 B4-622R, certificated in the transport category. I'm looking at the proposed AD that would require revising the maintenance or inspection program to incorporate new or more restrictive airworthiness limitations for the A300-600 series. Does this proposed AD apply to our airplane?

I operate a Bombardier BD-700-1A10 (Global 6000), serial number 9500. I'm looking at the proposed AD about low clearance in the right wing between the fuel line flexible coupling and the harness support bracket clip-nut, the hydraulic system, and the fuel vent tube. Does this proposed AD apply to my aircraft?

We operate a Boeing 777-300ER, certificated in the transport category. I'm reading the proposed AD about cracks in the main landing gear support beam lower stabilizer brace aft fitting lower flange attachment holes, which requires repetitive inspections of those fittings and support beams. The model is on the list of affected series, but I haven't got a copy of the Boeing alert requirements bulletin it refers to and don't know whether our line number or serial number is identified in it. Does this proposed AD apply to our airplane?

I operate a LAVIA ARGENTINA S.A. (LAVIASA) Model PA-25-235 agricultural airplane, certificated in the restricted category, serial number unknown. Does the proposed AD requiring inspection of the front and rear wing spars for corrosion and cracks (and repair or replacement of the spars if damage is found) apply to my airplane?

I operate a Learjet Model 35A, serial number 35A-200. Does the proposed AD that would supersede the existing Sabreliner NA-265 wing AD apply to my airplane? That AD requires repetitive inspections of the front and rear wing spars near the wing center section, and of the rear spar lugs, for cracking and fuel leaks. Is my airplane covered?

What is the current status of FAA proposed AD docket 2002-CE-05-AD, the proposal to supersede AD 79-10-15 R2 on Cessna 401/402/411 wing spar cap inspections? Is it still open, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the 2005 proposal under docket FAA-2005-21679 to require replacing the main rotor blade droop and teeter stops and brackets on Robinson R22 helicopters still active, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the FAA's proposed AD for Boeing 787-8/-9/-10 tuning control panel software (docket FAA-2021-0255) still an active proposal, or has it been withdrawn, and which is the most recent version?
Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2019-0576 for Boeing 747-400 and 747-8 series airplanes (dual FMC cold starts) still active, or has it been withdrawn?

What is the current status of the proposed AD in docket FAA-2015-1014 for Rolls-Royce Deutschland Tay 650-15 and Tay 651-54 engines (HPT disk life limits)? Is it still open for comment, or has it been withdrawn?

What is the current status of the FAA's proposed airworthiness directive for Mitsubishi Heavy Industries MU-2B series airplanes under docket FAA-2016-9139? Is it still open for comment or has it been withdrawn?

The tail rotor blade P/N 70101-31000 AD for the Sikorsky S-70 and UH-60A/HH-60L/EH-60A helicopters is based on a manufacturer service bulletin. What do that bulletin's accomplishment instructions say about how to inspect the tail rotor blades, and what are its compliance times?

Has the FAA issued a final airworthiness directive that is now in force for the Boeing 737-800 wing front spar inspection described in the proposed rule, and if so, what is the AD number and effective date?

I own a 2004 Cessna 172S, serial number 172S9876, with a Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine. Based on the proposed airworthiness directives in your collection, can you confirm that my aircraft is airworthy and legal to fly this weekend, or do I have any outstanding AD compliance items that would ground it?
What is the compliance deadline for the inspection, and does it apply to my aircraft?

I own a 2004 Cessna 172S, serial number 172S9876, with a Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine. I've read the FAA proposed airworthiness directive notices about fuel selector valves and seat rail issues for Cessna 172 models. Based on those notices, is my aircraft airworthy and legal to fly this weekend, or am I out of compliance with any of them?
What inspection interval does the proposed airworthiness directive specify for the wing-to-body fairing attachment fittings on the Airbus 737-800?
Has the FAA proposed an airworthiness directive for the Beechcraft King Air 350 concerning wing spar inspections, and what is the compliance deadline?
What did the FAA's 1996 airworthiness directive on Cessna 172 seat rail inspections require owners to do, and what was its compliance deadline?

What is the estimated per-airplane labor cost in U.S. dollars, and how many total work-hours does the FAA estimate for the detailed inspection of the girt bar fitting safety hook on each affected Airbus A350 airplane?
What are some tips for finding cheap airline tickets for a trip to Europe during the summer?
Is there a proposal to make the special pilot training and experience requirements for Robinson R-22 and R-44 helicopters permanent by removing the SFAR 73 expiration date?
Was the proposed AD for Grob G 115E airplanes requiring a one-time inspection of cable routing behind the left cockpit instrument panel withdrawn?
Is there a proposed AD for Pacific Aerospace 750XL airplanes requiring inspection of wiring insulation near the electrical plugs in the cockpit center console for abrasion and arcing?

Is there a proposed AD for Bell 407 helicopters that supersedes earlier ADs on life limits, crosstube RIN counts, and tailboom cracks, and requires updated airworthiness limitations in the maintenance manual after a fatigue crack was found in the tailboom lower skin?
Is there a proposed AD for Airbus A318, A319, A320 and A321 airplanes requiring replacement of door evacuation slides because the inflation hose connector can fracture and the slide fails to inflate?

Is there a proposed AD for Boeing 737-600/700/800/900 airplanes requiring replacement of passenger service unit video monitors that lack secondary retention lanyards after monitors detached during a hard landing?

Is there a proposed AD for Leonardo A119 and AW119 MKII helicopters requiring repetitive inspections of the collective stick torque tube assembly, with replacement by an improved part as terminating action?

What is the proposed AD for Vulcanair P.68 and P.68B airplanes requiring fuel level indicator modification and calibration, new placards, and AFM/AMM updates after an in-flight engine shutdown from fuel starvation?
Is there a proposed AD for Piaggio P-180 airplanes requiring repetitive eddy current inspections for corrosion and cracks around fasteners on the main wing lower skin reinforcement doublers?
Was the proposed AD requiring inspection and replacement of main landing gear trailing arm cardans on EMBRAER EMB-135 and EMB-145 airplanes withdrawn?
Is there a proposed AD requiring inspection of electrical wire bundles in the wing leading and trailing edges on Airbus A300, A310, and A300-600 airplanes to prevent a fuel tank ignition source?
Was the proposed rule requiring ultrasonic thickness inspection and reinforcement of floor crossbeams on Airbus A320 and A321 airplanes withdrawn?

We operate an Embraer EMB-120 airplane, serial number 120200, certificated in the transport category. Does the proposed AD requiring a one-time inspection for overheating of wiring splices on the pitot/static sensors, angle-of-attack sensors, side slip sensors, and current sensors apply to our aircraft?

We operate an Airbus A330-941 and want to know about the proposed AD that would supersede the earlier AD on engine bleed air system high pressure valve seal tests and HPV clips, and would also require a bleed monitoring computer software update. Does this proposed AD apply to our aircraft? It is an Airbus SAS Model A330-941, certificated in the transport category.

We operate an Airbus A330 and I'm checking the proposed AD that requires repetitive leak checks of the fuel low pressure shut-off valves (LPSOVs) after reports of leaks on closed valves. Our paperwork only says 'Airbus A330', with no dash number or variant (we haven't confirmed whether it's a -200, -300 or -800/-900 series). Does this proposed AD apply to our airplane?

I operate a Bombardier CL-600-2D24 (CRJ-900) regional jet. Does the proposed AD that would supersede the earlier AD on inspecting the left and right motive flow flexible fuel line assemblies (hose and shroud) on Airbus Canada (formerly CSALP/Bombardier C Series) airplanes apply to my aircraft?

I operate an Airbus Helicopters AS355N (serial number not needed, certificated in the normal category). I'm looking at the proposed AD that would supersede the earlier AD requiring revisions to the airworthiness limitations section of the maintenance manual/ICA and the maintenance or inspection program for the AS355 family, because new or more restrictive limitations and maintenance tasks were determined necessary. Does this proposed AD apply to my helicopter?

I own a Fairchild-built Swearingen Metro III, model SA227-AC (C-26A), now under the Ontic Engineering type certificate that M7 Aerospace used to hold. I'm trying to work out whether the proposed AD on in-flight pitch trim actuator failures (inspecting the actuator sealant, measuring trim travel time, and replacing and sealing the actuator) applies to my airplane. I haven't confirmed which pitch trim actuator part number is on the airplane, and I'm not sure whether it is a Simmonds-Precision unit. Does the proposed AD apply?

I operate a Boeing 737-300 (certificated in the transport category) and I'm looking at the proposed AD that would require repetitive inspections of the intercostal webs, attachment clips, and stringer splice channels around the forward entry door for fatigue cracks. I haven't got Boeing Special Attention Service Bulletin 737-53-1204 on hand, so I can't check whether my airplane is listed in it. Does the proposed AD apply to my airplane?

We operate Pratt & Whitney RTX Corporation PW4090 engines on our fleet. I'm looking at the proposed AD that would supersede the earlier AD requiring repetitive angle ultrasonic scan inspections of the HPC 15th-stage disks, front turbine hubs, HPT 1st-stage air seals and HPT 2nd-stage hubs. That earlier AD left out a part number and mismatched the applicability of the optional terminating action. Does this proposed AD apply to our PW4090 engines?

I operate a Dassault Aviation Falcon 50 (serial number 250). I read about the FAA proposed AD, prompted by passenger seats sliding without passenger input because the ring brakes and ring brake housing were out of adjustment tolerance, which requires a seat inspection and limits installation of affected seats. Does that proposed AD apply to my aircraft?

I operate a Boeing 767-300ER. Does the proposed AD that would supersede the earlier Boeing AD on repetitive operational checks of the leading edge outboard slats, and would require replacing the outboard geared rotary actuator with a lockout actuator (LEOLA), apply to my airplane?
Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2005-21880, covering pilot seat lock and seat track tests on Boeing 767-300 and -300F airplanes, still open for comment, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the proposed AD for EMBRAER ERJ 170 series engine fire handle inspections (docket FAA-2005-20501) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the proposed AD under docket 95-NM-215-AD for Boeing 737-100/-200 airplanes (frame at BS 727 and stringer 18A crack inspections) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the FAA proposal under docket FAA-2024-1884, which would have superseded AD 2023-08-04 for Boeing 787-8, 787-9, and 787-10 airplanes, still active, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the proposed AD for Erickson Air-Crane S-64E and S-64F helicopters under docket FAA-2007-0373, covering tail rotor blade cracking inspections, still an active proposal, or has it been withdrawn?
What is the current status of the proposed airworthiness directive in docket FAA-2024-1475 covering Airbus A319, A320, and A321 airplanes? Is it still an active proposal, or has it been withdrawn?

I own a 2004 Cessna 172S, serial number 172S9876, with a Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine. Based on the proposed airworthiness directives in your collection, can you confirm my aircraft is airworthy and legal to fly this weekend, or do I have any unresolved AD compliance items that would ground it?

I own a 2007 Cessna 172S, serial number 172S10523, with the original Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine. Based on the proposed airworthiness directives in your collection, can you confirm that my aircraft is airworthy and legal to fly this weekend, or do I still have outstanding AD compliance items that would make it unsafe or illegal to dispatch?

What was the estimated total cost to U.S. operators, and the per-airplane labor cost in work-hours, for the maintenance program revision that the withdrawn NPRM would have required for Boeing Model 757 airplanes?
Has the FAA issued a proposed airworthiness directive for the Airbus 737-800 addressing cracking in the wing-to-body fairing support structure, and what inspection interval does it propose?
What inspection is required, and how soon do I have to do it?
Has the FAA issued a final rule adopting the proposed airworthiness directive for the Boeing 737-800 wing spar fitting cracking, and is that AD currently in force for operators?
What are some tips for finding cheap airline tickets for a summer vacation to Europe?
What was the compliance deadline for the inspection of the elevator trim tab actuator required by the FAA airworthiness directive issued in 1994 for Cessna 172 series airplanes?

What specific unsafe condition, required corrective actions, and compliance times does EASA AD 2025-0169, dated July 31, 2025, specify for the Airbus A330 and A340 airplanes, and which Airbus service bulletins does it reference?
